title: Stone Soup
author: Classic (Traditional Folk Tale)

hero.name: Soldier / Traveller with pot
hero.description: A travelling stranger or soldier carrying a large pot, the central character who tricks the villagers into sharing by making 'stone soup'
hero.source_note: Generic traveller or soldier figure — Boardmaker 'man' or 'soldier' icon acceptable; no named/branded character

notes: Stone Soup is a classic folk tale about community and sharing. Key vocabulary centres on cooking actions (stir, add), food items (carrot, pot, stone, soup), and social concepts (share, together, hungry). 'Villager' represents the townsfolk characters; a generic 'person' or 'people' Boardmaker icon is suitable. The existing activity_images already cover pot, stone, carrot, water, village, spoon, turnip, bread, onion, potato, and aac_extras cover share, cook, stir, hungry — so the fringe selection here prioritises the most story-critical items including 'soup' (the finished product), 'fire' (cooking method), 'together' (the story's moral theme), and 'add' (the repeated action of villagers contributing ingredients). 'Villager' and 'hungry' are prioritised over vegetable duplicates already covered in existing assets.
